name: ppt-anything
description: Create, research, edit, present, and export image-native slide decks from Codex with a live in-editor Browser workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Build and edit complete slide decks inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: PPT Anything gives Codex the full presentation workflow: research, onboarding, outline creation, visual inspiration, image-native slide generation, conversational and mark-based editing, slide structure controls, restyling, live Browser preview, presenting, and PDF/PPTX export.
defaultPrompt: Open PPT Anything in the Codex Browser.
Research this topic, build a deck, and open the live preview.
Edit my latest deck and show the result in the Browser.
